notes.title: Stupid Cupid Available for Early Access Today!
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33699781/51a8eb3d46b80fb3d0fe8ac03fa2bb3d6377a6f4.png[/img]
Happy Valentine's Day! Wait…it's March 14. Oops. Cupid is late again, but he's finally here! 

We’re so excited that our new game Stupid Cupid is available for Early Access today. If you liked our previous games GrabBag and Hang Up, you’ll love this fun, quirky VR archery and puzzle matching game. Put yourself in Cupid’s shoes, test your skills and accuracy, and fix his mistakes!

As this is Shadow Factory's most ambitious game yet, it was important to us to release the game for Early Access and involve the Steam community throughout the development of the game.

So, folks, we need your feedback! Let us know what you love, what you don’t, and how we can improve Stupid Cupid as we finish the full version of the game. You can always reach our team at support@shadowfactory.io
 
Play Stupid Cupid: https://store.steampowered.com/app/974160/Stupid_Cupid/

notes.title: Hang Up 1.1 Update
notes.content:
Thanks to player feedback, we’ve made updates!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33699781/9f56a5a4a5f393e93b1e20791e1b68d78964207f.png[/img]

The Shadow Factory team recently made some "Quality of Life" updates, with improvements to player controls and narrative dependent gameplay mechanics:

[list]
[*] The switchboard now inserts audio jacks on trigger release, stopping players from accidentally inserting the jack into the wrong sockets.
[*] Players should see and be able to interpret feedback from the switchboard with more clarity, with improved sound and lighting effects.
[*] As players get closer to the end of their story, they should see more dramatic gameplay mechanics, spooks, and narrative elements.
[/list]

Thanks all who have played for your overwhelming response to Hang Up, and we look forward to sharing more.
